title: SPC Day 3-8 fire weather areas met their stated 70% and 40% levels overall against URMA in 2021-2026, but July-February areas verified about 0.25 lower than March-June areas
abstract: We verified the NOAA Storm Prediction Center probabilistic Day 3-8 fire weather outlooks for valid days from March 2021 to October 2026. Each area states the probability of critical wind, low RH and warm temperature for 3 hours or more within 12 miles of a point: 70% or 40%. The verifying data was the URMA 2.5 km analysis with the SPC critical criteria (20 mph, regional RH thresholds, 3 hours). We used all 690 70% areas, 1,370 40%-band areas digitised from the archived graphics, Day 1-2 areas, a random sample of other dates, and 35,941 ASOS station-days. Overall, critical conditions occurred over 0.78 (95% CI 0.74-0.81) of the 70% areas and 0.46 (0.41-0.51) of the 40% band, inside the stated ranges, with no decrease from Day 3 to Day 8. But in March-June 70% areas verified at 0.81 and in July-February at 0.56 (0.48-0.65); the 40% band verified at 0.54 and 0.33. The northern Great Basin, Rockies and northern Plains in July-February had the lowest values (0.47 and 0.27). There, low RH was common but 20 mph wind for 3 hours often did not occur. Day 1 Critical areas showed the same seasonal difference. Long-lead 40% areas without a later 70% upgrade verified at about 0.3. URMA under-detects critical hours relative to ASOS. With a station-calibrated URMA the seasonal difference stays, but the July-February values reach the stated floors at the CI edge. The below-floor summer values come mainly from 2024-2026. Limitations: fuels were not verified, the RH thresholds and 40% contours were digitised, and the season-region split was exploratory.

Left: Day 3-8 70% areas (blue) and Day 1 Critical areas (violet); shading shows the stated range (at least 0.70). Right: 40% band (stated 0.40-0.70). Bars are 95% date-bootstrap intervals; numbers are area counts.
Left: verified fraction by lead for Day 3-8 70% areas and the population-weighted 40% band, with stated ranges shaded. Right: Day 1-2 categorical areas verified with the same critical criteria.

Area fraction with each ingredient within 12 miles (wind 20 mph for 3 h, RH at or below the regional threshold for 3 h, both together, elevated criteria) in two well-verified spring regimes and two poorly verified July-February regimes.
